AN UNEXPECTED PHONE CALL
Story Bible & Script
STORY BIBLE
Premise: A young woman is stopped on a busy road by a call she did not expect.
Tone: Warm, grounded, Colombo in the rain.
CHARACTERS
ANUDI — 25, elegant, carries a tan leather handbag.
DASUN — 27, runs a small tea stall, wears a plain blue shirt.
FATHER — Anudi's father. Heard on the phone only. Saved in her phone as "Thaththe".
PROPS
Tan leather handbag | Smartphone with a cracked corner | Paper cup of tea
Story Bible & Script — Page 2
SCRIPT
EPISODE 1 — THE CALL
Duration: 1 minute
DASUN
(Smiling)
Miss! You dropped your phone.
ANUDI
Oh! Thank you.
She picks up her handbag. The phone rings. The screen shows "Thaththe".
ANUDI
(Nervous)
Hello, Thaththe?
Story Bible & Script — Page 3
EPISODE 2 — THE WAIT
Duration: 1 minute
Anudi sits at the stall. Dasun hands her a paper cup of tea.
DASUN
(Gently)
You do not have to go back yet.
ANUDI
I know.
ANUDI
(Softly)
මම ඔබ එනවා දැනගෙන හිටියා.
Story Bible & Script — Page 4
EPISODE 3 — THE ANSWER
Duration: 1 minute
Rain taps on the tarpaulin roof.
ANUDI
(Quietly)
I will tell him tonight.
DASUN
Then I will be here tomorrow.
